subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

To move or travel back and forth frequently
solution: The correct answer is: **Shuttle**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Shuttle **means to travel back and forth regularly between two points. (दो बिंदुओं के बीच नियमित रूप से आगे-पीछे यात्रा करना) • ​**Example**: *The airport shuttle transports passengers from the hotel to the airport and back.* • **Shuttle **can be used as a one-word substitute for "**to move or travel back and forth frequently.**" • The grammatical point here is the use of a verb to describe the action of moving back and forth, which is then replaced by a noun (shuttle) that represents the same action. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Grapple**: To struggle with something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति से संघर्ष करना) • **Rupture**: To break or burst suddenly. (अचानक टूटना या फूटना) • **Foster**: To encourage or promote the development of something/someone. (किसी चीज़/किसी के विकास को प्रोत्साहित करना या बढ़ावा देना) 34:Tc56, The correct answer is: **Praise**
